_context.chat.copy: Button that copies the link of a published page.
_context.chat.madePublicByYou: Status under a published link once the user agreed to make it public.
_context.chat.keptFor: Status under a published link once the user refused to make it public. {workspace} is the name of the workspace.
_context.share.title: Title of the dialog where the user chooses who can open a published link.
_context.share.publicOff: Why the Public option is greyed out. {workspace} is the name of the workspace.
_context.share.noEmail: Why the Invited option is greyed out: this self-hosted server is not set up to send emails.
_context.share.passwordSet: Placeholder of the password field when the link already has a password.
